name: com.nexus.ads.admob
description: Google AdMob (Google Mobile Ads Unity plugin, with User Messaging Platform consent): AdMobProvider, the com.nexus.ads family's IAdProvider (assembly Nexus.Ads.AdMob, compiles only with com.nexus.ads and the plugin 11.3.0+), and the legacy AdMobAdapter behind Nexus AdService, kept until its consumers move to the family.
